bekkerson.tagline: We have a guild for that.
bekkerson.blurb: Tech nerds with their own conference, their own podcast and a guild for guilds.

accentura.tagline: We have a deck for that.
accentura.blurb: Global, thorough and always ready with 140 slides and a partner flying in from Copenhagen.

knowitall.blurb: Broad, big and happy to acquire anything that stands still long enough.

soppsteria.blurb: Cheap, efficient and suspiciously good at delivering from several time zones at once.

kompottas.tagline: Everything's better with a bit of jam.
kompottas.blurb: Solid people with a taste for both architecture and waffles.

iteraigjen.tagline: We'll do it once more. And once more.
iteraigjen.blurb: Agile to the bone. The sprint is never quite over.

smiles.blurb: Small local offices and a wellbeing survey that always says 100%.

webstepdans.blurb: Rhythmic deliveries and a surprisingly good Christmas party show.

kantegne.tagline: We draw it first. On the whiteboard. For a while.
kantegne.blurb: Design-driven and proudly from Trondheim. The whiteboards are full.

tietoevig.tagline: Your project lasts forever. So do we.

bouffet.tagline: Help yourself. Every discipline on one table.

invariant.tagline: Same high quality, whatever the input.

reiterate.tagline: Have you tried turning it off and on again?

geita.blurb: Cloud specialists who are happiest where there are no railings.

fargestift.tagline: We colour in your cloud bill.
fargestift.blurb: Licences, cloud and a surprisingly large data department.

kappgjemini.blurb: Big, efficient and always ready to scale. Up and down.

nattlys.tagline: We light up the darkest backlogs.

hikkeq.blurb: Swedish quality and a weekly fika nobody is allowed to skip.

riddertech.blurb: Data engineers in shining armour. And hoodies.

rektor.tagline: My office. Bring a good PR.

futuriis.blurb: Finnish design house with a knack for service design and lunch.

solitaer.tagline: We play best alone, but deliver as a team.

trigaffel.blurb: Danish developers with their own conference and strong opinions on Erlang.

navet.name: NAVet

veivesen.name: Public Roads Office

helsesov.name: Health South-East-West

kommunenorge.name: Municipalities Inc.

laanekassen.name: Student Loans for Life

dnbank.name: DNBank

equinaer.name: Equinær

postenbring.name: Post & Bring-Me

kryptonitt.name: Kryptonitt

tipptopp.name: Norsk Tipp-Topp

rutah.name: Rutah

telenorr.name: Telenorr

sparebank123.name: SpareBank 1-2-3

awards.coffee_machine: Best Coffee Machine in the Industry

bankrupt.title: Bankrupt
